# PRÉ NETTOYAGE

## BASE UNIQUE

```{r Import1}

M1_A3 <- readr::read_csv("../../data_hors_git/process_data/thoa_M1_A3.csv",
                         show_col_types = F)

M4_A0 <- haven::read_sas("../../data_hors_git/raw_data/gb_ddb_id_01_fa_04.sas7bdat")

```

### Corriger données d'identité

```{r M4_A0 to M4_A2}

# Ajouter id_doublon
M4_A1 <- M4_A0 %>%
  left_join(
    M1_A3 %>% 
      select(id_anonymat:id_keep),
    by = "id_anonymat"
  ) %>% 
  relocate(id_doublon:id_keep, .after = id_anonymat) %>% 
  select(-id_sep, -id_type, -tab_db) %>% 
  haven::zap_label() %>% 
  haven::zap_formats() %>% 
  mutate(across(
    .cols = where(is.character),
    .fns = ~ na_if(., "")
  )) %>% 
  mutate(
    id_prenom = replace_when(
      id_prenom,
      id_prenom == "NA" ~ "NAA"
    )
  )

# Remplir les données manquantes de l'identité

M4_A2 <- M4_A1 %>% 
  rows_patch(
    M1_A3 %>% 
      select(any_of(colnames(M4_A1))),
    by = "id_anonymat",
    unmatched = "ignore"
  ) %>% 
  select(-(fa_type:id_age_cat_3))


```

### Retirer les colonnes vides

```{r M4_A2 to M4_A3}

empty_cols_M4_A2 <- M4_A2 %>%
  mutate(across(
    .cols = where(is.character),
    .fns = ~ na_if(., "")
  )) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.)))) %>% 
  pivot_longer(everything(),
               names_to = "variable",
               values_to = "nb_empty_cells") %>% 
  filter(nb_empty_cells == nrow(M4_A2))

### 1.1.3 Créer vecteur avec le nom des variables à retirer
vars_vides <- empty_cols_M4_A2$variable

### 1.1.4 Retirer les variables, corriger les formats et les NA character
M4_A3 <- M4_A2 %>%
  select(-all_of(vars_vides))

rm(list = c("empty_cols_M4_A2", "M4_A0", "M4_A1", "M4_A2", "vars_vides"))

```

```{r M4_A3 to M4_B0}
    "fa_pam_deces_an" = "fa_pam_an_deces",
    "fa_par_union" = "fa_par_union_parents",

    "fa_par_union_int_mois" = "fa_par_interromp_mois",
    "fa_par_union_int_an" = "fa_par_interromp_an",
    "fa_par_union_int_muco" = "fa_par_raison_muco",
    "fa_fr_fratrie" = "pf_fratrie",
    "fa_sf_rang_nais" = "pf_rang_nais"
  ) %>%

    fa_pam_prenom = str_to_upper(fa_pam_prenom),
    fa_pap_prenom = str_to_upper(fa_pap_prenom),
   fa_pam_prenom = replace_when(

    ))

rm(list = c("add_fa_fo", "add_fa_sf", "bouge", "mere", "pere", "parents",

```
 
### Identifier les absents

```{r M4_B0 to M4_B1}

vars_check <- M4_B0 %>%
  select(fa_cp_couple_1an:fa_sf_fratrie_adopte_nb) %>%
  colnames()

M4_B1 <- M4_B0 %>%
  mutate(
    absent = if_all(all_of(vars_check), is.na),
    .after = id_anonymat
  ) %>% 
  
  # Identifier ceux qui ont participé au module
  mutate(
    fa_complet = case_when(
      absent ~ 0L,
      !absent ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ -99L
    ),
    .after = id_anonymat
  ) %>% 
  select(-absent)

rm(vars_check)
```

### Retirer les doublons
 
```{r M4_B1 to M4_C0}

# Identifier les doublons
doublons <- M4_B1 %>% 
  group_by(id_keep) %>% 
  filter(n() > 1) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  relocate(c("id_doublon", "id_keep"), .after = id_anonymat) %>% 
  arrange(id_keep)

# Corriger les données d'identité issues du questionnaire

doublons_corr <- doublons %>%  
  mutate(
    id_anonymat = id_keep
  ) %>% 
  filter(fa_complet == 1)

# Joindre les données propres
M4_C0 <- M4_B1 %>% 
  filter_out(id_keep %in% doublons$id_keep) %>% 
  bind_rows(doublons_corr) %>% 
  arrange(id_anonymat)

rm(list = c("doublons", "doublons_corr"))
rm(list = c("M4_A3", "M4_B0", "M4_B1"))

```

## Recoder NAs
```{r}
rcd_simple_2 <- function(df, vars, complet){
  df %>% 
    mutate(
      across(
        {{vars}},
        ~ case_when(
          . == 99 ~ -8,
          . == 88 ~ -9,
          !is.na(.) ~ .,
          is.na(.) & {{complet}} == 1 ~ -9,
          is.na(.) & {{complet}} == 0 ~ -2,
          TRUE ~ -999
        )
      )
    )
}

rcd_vars_text <- function(df, vars, complet){
  df %>% 
    mutate(
      across(
        {{vars}},
        ~ case_when(
          !is.na(.) ~ .,
          is.na(.) & {{complet}} == 1 ~ "-9",
          is.na(.) & {{complet}} == 0 ~ "-2",
          TRUE ~ "-999"
        )
      )
    )
}

rcd_vars_borne1 <- function(df, borne, vars){
  df %>% 
    mutate(
      across(
        {{vars}},
        ~ case_when(
          !is.na(.) ~ .,
          {{borne}} == -2 ~ -2,
          {{borne}} == 0 & is.na(.) ~ -1,
          ({{borne}} == 1 | {{borne}} == -9) & is.na(.) ~ -9,
          TRUE ~ -999
        )
      )
    )
}

rcd_borne_bin <- function(df, borne, vars){
  df %>% 
    mutate(
      across(
        {{vars}},
        ~ case_when(
          !is.na(.) ~ .,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} == 1 ~ -9,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} == -2 ~ -2,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} == -9 ~ -9,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} == 0 ~ -1,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} == -1 ~ -1,
          TRUE ~ -999
        )
      )
    )
}

rcd_borne_opt1 <- function(df, borne, x, out, vars){
  df %>% 
    mutate(
      across(
        {{vars}},
        ~ case_when(
          . == 99 ~ -8,
          !is.na(.) ~ .,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} == x ~ -9,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} == -2 ~ -2,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} == -9 ~ -9,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} == -1 ~ -1,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} %in% {{out}} ~ -1,
          TRUE ~ -999
        )
      )
    )
}

rcd_borne_opt3 <- function(df, borne, x, out, vars){
  
  out[! out %in% x]
  
  df %>% 
    mutate(
      across(
        {{vars}},
        ~ case_when(
          . == 99 ~ -8,
          . == 88 ~ -9,
          !is.na(.) ~ .,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} == x ~ -9,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} == -2 ~ -2,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} == -9 ~ -9,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} == -1 ~ -1,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} %in% {{out}} ~ -1,
          TRUE ~ -999
        )
      )
    )
}

rcd_borne_opt2 <- function(df, borne, inc, y, vars){
  df %>% 
    mutate(
      across(
        {{vars}},
        ~ case_when(
          !is.na(.) ~ .,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} %in% {{inc}} ~ -9,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} == -2 ~ -2,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} == -9 ~ -9,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} == -1 ~ -1,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} == y ~ -1,
          TRUE ~ -999
        )
      )
    )
}

```


```{r M4_C3 to M4_D0}

simple <- M4_C3 %>% 
  select(fa_pap_nais_mois:fa_pap_deces, fa_pap_etudes, fa_pap_statut,
         fa_pam_nais_mois:fa_pam_deces, fa_pam_etudes, fa_pam_statut,
         fa_par_union:fa_par_union_int,
         fa_fo_vie, fa_fo_vous_ress:fa_fo_revenus_an,
         fa_sf_matrimoniale:fa_sf_fratrie_adopte_nb) %>% 
  colnames()

texte <- M4_C3 %>% 
  select(fa_pap_prenom, fa_pap_prof, fa_pam_prenom, fa_pam_prof) %>% 
  colnames()

deces_pere <- M4_C3 %>% 
  select(contains("pap_deces_")) %>% 
  colnames()

deces_mere <- M4_C3 %>% 
  select(contains("pam_deces_")) %>% 
  colnames()

job_pere <- M4_C3 %>% 
  select(fa_pap_entreprise, fa_pap_qual) %>% 
  colnames()

job_mere <- M4_C3 %>% 
  select(fa_pam_entreprise, fa_pam_qual) %>% 
  colnames()

inc_job <- c(-9, -8, 2, 3)

separation <- M4_C3 %>% 
  select(fa_par_union_int_nat:fa_par_union_int_muco) %>% 
  colnames()

out_interruption <- c(0)

out_fo_vie <- c(1:6)
fo_conjt <- M4_C3 %>% 
  select(fa_fo_conjt_prof, fa_fo_conjt_ress) %>% 
  colnames()

fo_parent <- M4_C3 %>% 
  select(fa_fo_parent_prof, fa_fo_parent_ress) %>% 
  colnames()

fo_both <- M4_C3 %>% 
  select(fa_fo_pere_prof, fa_fo_mere_prof, fa_fo_vos_parents_ress) %>% 
  colnames()

fo_autre <- M4_C3 %>% 
  select(fa_fo_membres_prof, fa_fo_membres_ress) %>% 
  colnames()

M4_D0 <- M4_C3 %>% 
  rcd_simple_2(all_of(simple), fa_complet) %>% 
  rcd_vars_text(all_of(texte), fa_complet) %>% 
  rcd_borne_bin(fa_pap_deces, all_of(deces_pere)) %>% 
  rcd_borne_bin(fa_pam_deces, all_of(deces_mere)) %>% 
  rcd_borne_opt2(fa_pap_statut, inc_job, 1, all_of(job_pere)) %>% 
  rcd_borne_opt2(fa_pam_statut, inc_job, 1, all_of(job_mere)) %>% 
  rcd_borne_opt1(fa_par_union_int, 1, out_interruption, all_of(separation)) %>% 
  rcd_borne_opt3(fa_fo_vie, 3, out_fo_vie, all_of(fo_conjt)) %>% 
  rcd_borne_opt3(fa_fo_vie, 4, out_fo_vie, all_of(fo_parent)) %>% 
  rcd_borne_opt3(fa_fo_vie, 5, out_fo_vie, all_of(fo_both)) %>% 
  rcd_borne_opt3(fa_fo_vie, 6, out_fo_vie, all_of(fo_autre))

rm(list = c("simple", "texte", "deces_mere", "deces_pere", "job_pere",
            "job_mere", "separation", "fo_conjt", "fo_parent", 
            "fo_both", "fo_autre", "inc_job", "out_interruption",
            "out_fo_vie"))
  
```

```{r M4_D0 to M4_D1}

M4_D1 <- M4_D0 %>% 
  mutate(
    fa_fo_vie_autre = case_when(
      !is.na(fa_fo_vie_autre) ~ fa_fo_vie_autre,
      is.na(fa_fo_vie_autre) & fa_fo_vie == -2 ~ "-2",
      is.na(fa_fo_vie_autre) & fa_fo_vie == -9 ~ "-9",
      is.na(fa_fo_vie_autre) & fa_fo_vie %in% c(1:6) ~ "-1",
      TRUE ~ "-999"
    ),
    fa_fo_revenus_corr = case_when(
      !is.na(fa_fo_revenus_corr) ~ fa_fo_revenus_corr,
      is.na(fa_fo_revenus_corr) & fa_complet == 0 ~ "F-[MODULE SAUTÉ]",
      is.na(fa_fo_revenus_corr) & fa_complet == 1 ~ "E-[NSPR - NSP]",
      TRUE ~ "-999"
    )
  ) %>% 
  # Variable inutile
  select(-fa_fo_revenus)
```

## Modifier NAs character

```{r M4_D1 to M4_D2}

vars_char_to_rcd <- M4_D1 %>% 
  select(where(~ is.character(.) && any(str_starts(., "-\\d"), na.rm = T))) %>% 
  colnames()


M4_D2 <- M4_D1 %>% 
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(vars_char_to_rcd), ~ replace_when(
        .x,
        str_starts(.x, "-\\d") ~ NA_character_
      )
    )
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    fa_fo_revenus_cat = case_when(
      fa_fo_revenus_corr == "A-[<7.200 - <17.170]" ~ 1,
      fa_fo_revenus_corr == "B-[17.170 - <28.000]" ~ 2,
      fa_fo_revenus_corr == "C-[28.000 - <45.400]" ~ 3,
      fa_fo_revenus_corr == "D-[45.400 - >104.550]" ~ 4,
      fa_fo_revenus_corr == "E-[NSPR - NSP]" ~ NA_integer_,
      fa_fo_revenus_corr == "F-[MODULE SAUTÉ]" ~ NA_integer_
    ),
    .after = fa_fo_revenus_corr
    ) %>% 
  select(-fa_fo_revenus_corr, -(id_centre1:id_age), -id_doublon, -id_keep, -id_date_creation)  

# Pour vérifier
M4_D1 %>% 
  select(all_of(vars_char_to_rcd)) %>% 
  summarise(across(all_of(vars_char_to_rcd), ~ sum(is.na(.))))

M4_D2 %>%
```

## Traduire réponses libres

```{r}

vars_libres <- M4_E4 %>% 
  select(where(is.character)) %>% 
  select(-id_anonymat, -ends_with("prenom")) %>% 
  colnames()

library(dplyr)
library(purrr)


# 2. Valeurs uniques, non vides, sur les 6 variables à la fois
textes_uniques <- M4_E4 %>%
  select(all_of(vars_libres)) %>%
  unlist(use.names = FALSE) %>%
  unique() %>%
  discard(~ is.na(.x) || trimws(.x) == "")

fichier_dico <- "dico_fam_traduction.rds"

# Reprend là où on s'était arrêté, si une sauvegarde existe
dico <- if (file.exists(fichier_dico)) readRDS(fichier_dico) else character(0)

traduire <- function(x, essais = 5) {
  for (i in seq_len(essais)) {
    res <- tryCatch(
      google_translate(x, target_language = "en",
                                 source_language = "fr"),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (length(res) == 1 && !is.na(res)) return(res)
    attente <- 10 * 2^(i - 1)  # 10 s, 20 s, 40 s, 80 s, 160 s
    message("Échec, nouvel essai dans ", attente, " s...")
    Sys.sleep(attente)
  }
  NA_character_
}

a_traduire <- setdiff(textes_uniques, names(dico))

for (i in seq_along(a_traduire)) {
  txt <- a_traduire[i]
  dico[txt] <- traduire(txt)
  Sys.sleep(1)  # pause entre chaque requête
  if (i %% 20 == 0) {
    saveRDS(dico, fichier_dico)
    message(i, " / ", length(a_traduire), " traduits")
  }
}
saveRDS(dico, fichier_dico)

M4_E5 <- M4_E4 %>%

                .names = "{.col}_en"))

  M4_E5 <- relocate(M4_E5, all_of(paste0(v, "_en")), .after = all_of(v))
}
```

# META DATA


```{r}
M4_E7 <- haven::read_dta("/Users/alicethomassin/Muco 2026/data_hors_git/Peter/thoa4_1Family_454.dta")

dico_fa <- generate_dictionary(M4_E7) %>% 
  convert_list_columns_to_character() %>% 
  select(variable, label, col_type, value_labels) %>% 
  mutate(
    origin = if_else(str_detect(label, "^[A-Z]+\\d+ "), "question", "derived"),
    ref = if_else(
      (col_type == "chr" & origin == "question" & !str_detect(variable, "(_nom)|(_prenom)")), 
      paste0(str_extract(label, "^[A-Z]+\\d+"), "_txt"), 
      str_extract(label, "^[A-Z]+\\d+"))
  ) %>% 
    relocate(ref, .after = variable) %>% 
    group_by(ref, col_type) %>% 
    mutate(
      n_obs = n(),
      ref = replace_when(
        ref,
        str_detect(label, "(MR)") ~ paste0(ref, "_", row_number()),
        !is.na(ref) & n_obs > 1 & col_type != "chr" ~ paste0(ref, "_", row_number())
      )
    ) %>% 
      ungroup() %>% 
      mutate(
        order = row_number()
      ) %>% 
        relocate(order) %>% 
        select(-n_obs)

```

```{r}
family <- readr::read_csv("data_hors_git/meta_questions/family.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

meta_fa <- family %>% 
  mutate(
    ref = str_replace_all(variable, "-", "0"),
    ref = str_replace_all(ref, "_(?!txt$)[[:alpha:]]+$", ""),
    ref = str_replace_all(ref, "0(?=\\d{2,})", ""),
    .before = variable
  ) %>% 
    group_by(ref) %>% 
    mutate(
      n_obs = n(),
      ref = if_else(n_obs > 1, paste0(ref, "_", row_number()), ref),
      ref = if_else(ref == "F29", paste0(ref, "_txt"), ref),
      ref = if_else(ref == "F38", paste0(ref, "_txt"), ref)
    ) %>% 
      ungroup() %>% 
    select(-variable, -n_obs) %>% 
  right_join(
    dico_fa %>% select(order, variable, ref),
    by = "ref",
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) %>% 
    relocate(variable) %>% 
    filter(!is.na(variable)) %>% 
    mutate(
      notes_fr = NA_character_,
      notes_en = NA_character_,
      skip_pattern_en = skip_pattern,
      skip_pattern_fr = NA_character_,
      source_fr = NA_character_,
      source_en = NA_character_
    ) %>% 
      relocate(order) %>% 
      arrange(order) %>% 
      select(-order) %>% 
      relocate(c("skip_pattern_fr", "skip_pattern_en"), .after = question_en) %>%
      relocate(c("source_fr", "source_en"), .after = skip_pattern_en) %>% 
      select(-skip_pattern, -source)
```

```{r}

dossier <- "data_hors_git/meta_updated"
fichiers <- list.files(dossier, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

dir.create(file.path(dossier, "backup"), showWarnings = FALSE)
file.copy(fichiers, file.path(dossier, "backup"))

nouvelles <- c("filter_fr", "filter_en")

for (f in fichiers) {
  meta <- read.csv(f, colClasses = "character", fileEncoding = "UTF-8", check.names = FALSE)
  
  # Ajouter les colonnes seulement si elles n'existent pas encore
  for (col in nouvelles) {
    if (!col %in% names(meta)) meta[[col]] <- ""
  }
  
  # Placer les nouvelles colonnes juste après skip_pattern
  autres <- setdiff(names(meta), nouvelles)
  meta <- meta[, append(autres, nouvelles, after = match("skip_pattern_en", autres))]
  
  a_deplacer <- grepl("^Asked if", meta$skip_pattern_en)
  meta$filter_en[a_deplacer & meta$filter_en == ""] <- meta$skip_pattern_en[a_deplacer & meta$filter_en == ""]
  meta$skip_pattern_en[a_deplacer] <- ""

  write.csv(meta, f, na = "", row.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
}
```
